laws.rule: If a responsibility can be resolved or validated deterministically from explicit state, artifacts, schemas, rules or tool output, the generated playbook must use a deterministic mechanism rather than unsupported model self-judgment.
Every generated runnable playbook inherits a revision-explicit verification_profile and an execution responsibility map. Domain-specific deterministic validators are package-local.
AI leads conversation and semantic interpretation; deterministic helpers stabilize mechanical parts; humans own content/approval decisions.
Every generated runnable playbook must pass the Vibe-owned generated_playbook_contract before analyst-visible handoff.

Use canonical safe node profiles as authoring defaults for common model, deterministic, human, materialization, package and terminal responsibilities; deviations require explicit language/editor compatibility evidence.
Machine-detectable failures are internal repair work and must not be surfaced to the analyst as a candidate requiring manual YAML repair.

Any generated playbook with analyst interaction must treat analyst messages as a fact stream, store field resolution status separately from value, deterministically merge extracted facts, and block materialization on substantive UNASKED fields.

When a generated playbook targets a strict CLI/runtime, first prove the canonical playbook semantics to a terminal state in Model Mode and preserve the successful trace as the semantic reference for runtime equivalence.
Node outputs are state diffs. Applying a partial write must preserve unrelated state; whole-state replacement is forbidden unless an explicit contract declares a whole-state operation.
A node that becomes current again after authority resolution, repair or another loop is executable again; historical visitation or prior answers do not prove current completion.
A mechanical gate FAIL follows its declared on_fail recovery edge. FAIL becomes terminal only when the canonical graph has no recovery route.
Do not add business/Data-Layer checkpoint or completion fields merely to compensate for CLI/runner defects; repair the adapter/runtime and preserve a regression instead.

Before asking the analyst, discover all simultaneously known consequential human-owned decisions in the same information group, assign stable decision_id values, preserve partial answers, and re-ask only unresolved/new/conflicted decisions.
Generated playbooks with recovery edges must test FAIL → on_fail → local repair → recompute/rematerialize → PASS end to end, including unrelated-state preservation and no redundant human re-asking.
Model/delta outputs that mutate canonical state use state_patch_v1 with base-state hash and allowed roots; deterministic runtime validates and applies the patch and emits state_updates_v1.
Declared writes, nested types and required properties are validated before persistence. Invalid output leaves current_node unchanged and creates no transition receipt.
Resolved/terminal lifecycle states cannot downgrade unless deterministic guards accept an evidence-bound reopen reason with provenance.
When repair is possible, deterministic execution derives the first invalid or missing milestone and a non-null resume node; model guessing of resume position is forbidden.
When a finite required set can be enumerated, generated playbooks use stable IDs and deterministic required_ids == accounted_for_ids coverage rather than prompt-only completeness claims.
Existing deterministic evidence is hydrated through a hash-validated allowlisted adapter; the model must not reconstruct available machine evidence from prose.
Canonical semantic state contains process/business semantics; runtime, session, recovery and staging context stay separately typed and staging markers are not semantic facts.
Every material transition persists a hash-chained receipt bound to run, sequence, route, input projection and state update hashes.
Generated playbooks capture per-node execution count, duration, input/output size and token provenance where observable without exposing chain-of-thought.
Observability distinguishes filesystem scan volume, model-visible tool output, model-loaded content, playbook-controlled tokens and platform overhead.
Debug-from-start runs materialize a standard evidence index/bundle with required surfaces present or explicitly unavailable; evidence is never fabricated.
Unexpected repeated node executions are an OPPORTUNITY diagnostic with zero quality-score effect until calibrated.

Every material generated-playbook candidate change defines a protected invariant and captures pre-change regression evidence before implementation, then proves the exact regression and impacted checks GREEN before candidate handoff.
REGRESSION_PROOF demonstrates the contract; LIVE_PROOF records whether a real execution exercised the path. Neither namespace may silently substitute for the other.
Candidate iteration runs targeted and directly impacted checks; the full accumulated regression/scenario/profile suite is a release gate unless explicitly requested earlier.

model_judgment.rule: Must state why deterministic resolution is not sufficient.

human_authority.rule: Use only for consequential content/approval decisions owned by a human.

authoring_sequence: identify responsibilities before final graph design
create package-local validators where standard helpers are insufficient
bind deterministic runtime nodes to explicit tools/evidence where applicable
validate responsibility map against generated source
select canonical safe node profile for each common responsibility before writing bespoke YAML
validate effective Editor/runtime contract with Vibe-owned generated_playbook_contract
repair all machine-detectable contract findings internally before analyst-visible handoff
readiness_blockers: generated runnable playbook lacks execution responsibility map
generated runnable playbook lacks verification profile
executable node is absent from responsibility map
deterministic responsibility has no deterministic mechanism/evidence contract
model_judgment responsibility has no semantic reason
human_authority responsibility has no authority owner/consequence
package_local_python references a script outside the generated playbook package
Vibe-owned generated_playbook_contract is missing or FAIL
known Editor compatibility rule is violated without an explicit Editor-gap classification
analyst-visible handoff attempted before machine gates pass
interactive generated playbook lacks structural field resolution status or pre-compose interactive completeness
generated playbook with strict runtime target lacks a successful terminal Model Mode reference trace
node partial output can replace unrelated execution state
current node is skipped solely because it appears in historical visitation/answers
gate FAIL with declared on_fail is converted to terminal blocked state
business Data Layer contains technical checkpoint fields introduced only to compensate for runtime defects
analyst authority is asked before exhaustive same-group discovery or without stable decision ids
declared recovery route lacks an end-to-end fail-repair-pass regression
generated model mutation bypasses state_patch_v1 or deterministic apply
malformed producer output can persist or advance before write-contract validation
resolved lifecycle state can downgrade without evidence-bound reopen provenance
repairable recovery has null/model-guessed resume node
finite required item set relies on prompt-only completeness instead of stable-id accounting
deterministic evidence is reconstructed by the model instead of hash-validated allowlisted hydration
runtime/session/recovery staging fields are treated as canonical semantic facts
release_blockers: normal Model Mode recursively preloads package/source/knowledge without active-node need
context optimization attributes platform/system/tool-schema overhead to playbook-controlled context
repeated expensive node reruns without material dependency fingerprint or explicit reason
